clips.title: The story
paras: In Dun Morogh, Thick Bear Fur keeps travelers and soldiers warm against the mountain cold. The pelts come from bears roaming the snowfields and help make insulated clothing and bedding.

Bears roam Dun Morogh's ridges through some of the harshest snowfields in the Eastern Kingdoms. Their thick coats protect them from blizzards, and locals and travelers put those pelts to use. Hunters gather them to line clothing, insulate drafty outposts, and pad cold sleeping rolls.

Pilot Bellowfiz outfitted his siege tank, Jetsteam, at Steelgrill's Depot for a month in the field on a long mission for the Siege Brigade. Cold iron offered little comfort in the high snowbanks, so he hired local scouts to gather thick bear fur from the snowfields south of the Grizzled Den. The pelts would make warm bedding for his cabin quarters.
